programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Grow Old Along With Me
programme.desc: Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) and Forbes (Carl Weathers) link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: Soldier Boyz
programme.desc: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them?

programme.title: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In 72 hours a meteor will collide with Earth and annihilate mankind. Singapore's government tells its citizens to let loose for once and do absolutely anything they please.

programme.title: Armed Response
programme.desc: Trained operatives find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound after its artificial intelligence is suddenly shut down. There, they begin to experience strange and horrific phenomena.

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Soul Men
programme.desc: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater.

programme.title: Sprung
programme.desc: Clyde (Joe Torry) and his photographer pal Montel (Rusty Cundieff) meet gold digger Adina (Paula Jai Parker) and her friend Brandy (Tisha Campbell), a law student, at a party. While Clyde convinces Adina that he's wealthy, Montel and Brandy pair off and get along well. Adina is furious when she learns Clyde has misled her, but when they learn their friends plan to marry -- which would force the two enemies to spend time together -- they put their differences aside to thwart the marriage.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: La Ley de las Calles
programme.desc: Después de cuatro años un hombre es liberado de la cárcel y al salir es atacado por los hermanos de su novia.

programme.title: El Superman...Dilon 2
programme.desc: Marido abusa de su mujer y de la promesa que ella le hizo de obedecerlo en todo si él sacara a su madre de la cárcel.

programme.title: Cinco Nacos Asaltan Las Vegas
programme.desc: Un burócrata desempleado y cuatro amigos viajan a Las Vegas para asaltar un casino.

programme.title: Visita al Pasado
programme.desc: Un grupo de niños que viaja a través del tiempo al siglo XVII hacen frente a un castillo embrujado.

programme.title: Santo contra el doctor Muerte
programme.desc: Santo investiga la desaparición de obras de arte originales que fueron suplantadas por copias baratas.

programme.title: El oreja rajada
programme.desc: Dos niños angustiados y un campesino hacen todo lo posible por salvar a un purasangre. El ranchero Andrés quiere deshacerse de él, pero al final reconoce los méritos del caballo.

programme.title: La mafia amarilla
programme.desc: Una pandilla china asesina a un hombre y Blue Demon, con la ayuda de su amigo, tiene que encontrar al culpable.

programme.title: Caballos de acero
programme.desc: Un joven rico es aficionado al motociclismo y conoce a un teniente de la policía con quien rivaliza en aptitudes.

programme.title: Noche de muerte
programme.desc: Un delincuente se disfraza como un famoso luchador y asalta varios lugares matando a los guardias de seguridad.

programme.title: La cárcel de Laredo
programme.desc: Un hombre poderoso separa a su hija del novio, un mecánico, y lo envía a la prisión, a pesar de que la joven está embarazada.

programme.title: La venganza de un matón
programme.desc: María, una bailarina de salón, conoce a Ted y se enamoran. Ella queda embarazada, pero Ted sufre un accidente donde pierde la memoria y queda muy herido. Cuatro años después de su recuperación, va en busca de María.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don conducts a personal grand tour around Italy's magnificent gardens from the luxurious retreats of the moneyed north to the lavish hideaways of the romantic south. In this episode, he's in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is on a grand tour around Italy, this time visiting gardens both in Florence and around the sun-scorched Tuscan countryside. Monty discovers how, like a piece of sculpture, renaissance gardens were created as works of art, and how a group of Edwardian ex-pats mistakenly reinforced the idea that formal Italian gardens were flowerless.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don continues his grand garden tour of Italy. This time he is in Naples to visit some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After all the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the dramatic scenery of the Amalfi Coast to discover why, in the south, gardens are informal and, above all, filled with flowers.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don concludes his garden tour of Italy in the wealthy north where, in the Veneto and Lucca, extravagant pleasure gardens were created for flirtation and fun. In the Lakes, Monty meets up with the garden society, the Grandi Giardini Italiani, to peer over the fence at luxurious creations of the rich and famous. The journey ends on Lake Maggiore to see the most theatrical horticultural gem of Italy.
programme.sub-title: The Veneto, Lucca and The Lakes

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty's in the jewel garden showing which plants need protection from the elements now and which ones can be left until after the first frosts. programme.title: Gardeners' World

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Hell Fest
programme.desc: On Halloween night, three young women and their respective boyfriends head to Hell Fest -- a ghoulish traveling carnival that features a labyrinth of rides, games and mazes. They soon face a bloody night of terror when a masked serial killer turns the horror theme park into his own personal playground.

programme.title: Sorority Row
programme.desc: Cassidy (Briana Evigan), Jessica (Leah Pipes), Ellie (Rumer Willis), Claire (Jamie Chung) and Megan (Audrina Patridge) are sorority sisters and true-blue friends to the end -- until a prank gone wrong results in Megan's demise. Rather than risk their futures by reporting the crime, the friends agree to cover it up. Cassidy and company come to regret the decision a year later when someone begins sending them videos of the night Megan died, and they fall victim to a deadly stalker.

programme.title: Sorority Party Massacre

programme.desc: An ex-Los Angeles police officer (Richard Farnsworth) tracks an escaped prisoner (Michael Paré) on a 22nd-century prison planet.

programme.title: Solar Crisis
programme.desc: An admiral's (Charlton Heston) son (Tim Matheson) leads a 21st-century spaceship on a mission to save Earth from the sun.

programme.title: The Colony
programme.desc: An astronaut is shipwrecked on a long-decimated Earth during a research mission. With her crew mates killed or wounded, she alone must decide the fate of the wasteland's remaining populace.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: A young man named Bran Marshall flees from Earth through the gate to find a new home on Rhea. However, the early human settlers of Rhea decide that they will no longer accept refugees from Earth.

programme.title: Ender's Game
programme.desc: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

programme.title: Divergent
programme.desc: Tris Prior lives in a futuristic world in which society is divided into five factions. As each person enters adulthood, he or she must choose a faction and commit to it for life. Tris chooses Dauntless -- those who pursue bravery above all else. However, her initiation leads to the discovery that she is a Divergent and will never be able to fit into just one faction. Warned that she must conceal her status, Tris uncovers a looming war which threatens everyone she loves.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Insurgent
programme.desc: Now on the run from Jeanine and the rest of the power-hungry Erudites, Tris and Four search for allies and answers in the ruins of Chicago. They must find out what Tris' family sacrificed their lives to protect and why the Erudites will do anything to stop them. Side by side, Tris and Four face one seemingly insurmountable challenge after another, as they unravel the secrets of the past and -- ultimately -- the future of their world.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing the stakes are no longer just for survival, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) teams up with her closest friends, including Peeta (Josh Hutcherson), Gale (Liam Hemsworth) and Finnick for the ultimate mission. Together, they leave District 13 to liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem and assassinate President Snow, who's obsessed with destroying Katniss. What lies ahead are mortal traps, dangerous enemies and moral choices that will ultimately determine the future of millions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: Bunks

With help from some gadgets and two former spy kids, Rebecca and Cecil join the fight to save Earth.

programme.title: Employee of the Month
programme.desc: Zack (Dane Cook) and Vince (Dax Shepard) are rival co-workers at Super Club, the country's largest bulk-discount retailer, but while Vince is on the fast track at Super Club, Zack's laid-back approach to work holds him back. That all changes when a new cashier, named Amy (Jessica Simpson), transfers to their store. Zack is instantly smitten, but Amy prefers Vince. Zack determines that the only way to win her is to win his store's most coveted honor.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: The recently deceased Mona Dearly was many things: an abusive wife, a domineering mother, a loud-mouthed neighbor and a violent malcontent. So when her car and corpse are discovered in the Hudson River, police Chief Wyatt Rash immediately suspects murder rather than an accident. But, since the whole community of Verplanck, N.Y., shares a deep hatred for this unceasingly spiteful woman, Rash finds his murder investigation overwhelmed with potential suspects.

programme.title: Down a Dark Hall
programme.desc: Five emotionally fragile teens are committed to Blackwood, a mysterious school for gifted girls. Mesmerized by the intense head mistress Madame Duret, they think they have found a place where they can finally flourish academically and artistically. The mystery deepens as they break through layer after layer of misdirection to discover the true, horrifying purpose of the school.

programme.title: Engine Power

programme.title: Truck Tech

programme.sub-title: Rebuilding the Rear End of a Chevy K1500

programme.title: Engine Power

programme.sub-title: 632 ci Big Block Chevy Build for Project Wild & Willys

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: From vision to venom an iconic Ford Foxbody Cobra is transformed into a track ready ground pounder! Marc and Tommy wake up this sleepy snake and convert it into a Mustang with plenty of bite! Hello Project Sydewinder!

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Caprice Wagon is back in the shop for the rest of its upgrades. Jimmy and Jeremy add a new drivetrain to give our cruiser a boost in horsepower and then we add a few custom touches before taking the whole tribe on a cross town adventure in the Carcass family truckster.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our GM LQ9 engine needs the right ingredients to turn it into a spicy hot rod street bullet.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: It's bedtime! Today, Eric and Joel are laying down the freshly painted back end on our 1993 Dodge W350-Project Nightshift. We'll address the fuel system and core support, and slap on an all-new exhaust, getting us one step closer to the finish line.

programme.title: MuscleCar
programme.desc: The car has to be converted from automatic to manual floor pedals, and the firewall gets some factory style mods that change the car over to big-block style. Then, everything you ever wanted to know about brake lines and fuel lines.
programme.sub-title: Sleeving a 396 Big Block for a 1970 Camaro

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass duo fab up some custom body mounts for a first look at the Chevy M1010 and Willys Wagon combo. Plus, a sneak peak at the powerhouse that will drive it all.
programme.sub-title: Dropping Our '53 Willy's Wagon Body On Its New Chassis

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: A 25th anniversary Camaro transforms into an Autocross beast. New Power, new suspension, and an aero package allow this 30 year old car grip the pavement.
programme.sub-title: Autocross Camaro is Gets a New Suspension and Aero Package to Grip the Pavement

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The EBC Brakes giveaway 2020 F150 gets body mods and other upgrades for a sporty dream truck appearance.
programme.sub-title: A Sport Truck Deserves Serious Brakes: 2020 F-150 Brake Upgrade

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The '72 Camaro gets stripped down for a fresh coat of paint and a race-ready wrap. Then we'll reassemble and head to the track to see just how fast we can go!
programme.sub-title: Road Course Camaro Part 14 That's A Wrap

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: Our Small Block Chevy cracked during a cold snap. So we're going to take its guts, put them in a bigger 406ci block, and prep it for bigger power!

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Marc and Tommy finish up the interior of our '66 Pontiac convertible. Plus we head out on another Driveway Rescue helping a viewer with their '69 Cutlass project.

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass crew makes body modifications to our 1978 280Z that take on some JDM styling cues. And we're in the paint booth to show you how to make your paint come out smooth as glass.
programme.sub-title: Adding JDM Styling Cues To The 1978 Datsun 280Z Heritage Restomod

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: It's mod-mayhem as we trick out our Trailgater with all the toys you'll need for the ultimate tailgating experience. Eric and Joel use all of the cool features on our 2025 Nissan Frontier to install a fridge, grill, and TV setup so you can have everything you'll need at your fingertips on game day.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We lay out our plan to rebuild our 1985 Chevy K-10. We start by tearing it down and building it back up with new sheet metal repair. What we have in mind for this truck will make you do a double-take!
programme.sub-title: Diving Deep Into The Tear Down Of The Faux Guy Square Body

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The MCT Crew have the frame shortened on Project Cream Puff and it's ready for its new bed. The guys give you a couple of options on how to tackle a short bed conversion, then start assembling their new one. Plus, get a little help with choosing what kind of floor we want for our custom C-10.
programme.sub-title: Chevy C-10 - Part 4: Making The Bed

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Have you ever seen a super-charged Charger? Tommy and Peyton embark on their next project, a 2019 Dodge Charger, and give it a full super charger upgrade to make sure one lucky Detroit Muscle fan walks away with a sweet ride.

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel kick off a new project, a 1971 Chevy Caprice. They search through a big-body boneyard to find the inspiration to help separate this car from stereotypical b-body builds.
programme.sub-title: Tearing Down A 1971 Chevy Caprice - Fat Stack Part 1

programme.title: XOR - Xtreme Off-Road
programme.desc: We tear into our 2012 Jeep JK to begin its transformation into Project Creep It Real!

programme.title: Carcass
programme.desc: The Carcass builders bring in an old 1984 Chevrolet Land Yacht to give it some custom touches for some family fun. They will tear down and clean up 40 years of dirt, then start replacing worn out suspension parts to get this wagon road worthy.

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: The guys from MCT take their classic Chevy C-10 and transform it into a work of art. They'll tackle body work to lay down a flawless pearl two-tone finish. Whether you're an experienced builder or just love the beauty of custom trucks, they'll show tips, techniques, and tricks to help bring your own project to life. Plus, Mike and Anthony give us a little tour of their own C-10 projects.

programme.title: Engine Power
programme.desc: We wrap up our 427ci LSx engine build for the Music City Trucks' C10 so it can hit the engine dyno! We're topping this engine with a high flowing induction package, stand-alone EFI, and classic small block look. We'll tune it up on the dyno to make pump gas power that will dominate the street!

programme.title: PowerNation on the Road
programme.desc: Our team takes you through an exclusive look at the SEMA 2018 Show in Las Vegas where there are 150,000 manufacturers, buyers, and automotive industry professionals together for the largest car and truck convention. And while the public's not invited, we give you a look at exactly what goes on there. The Special Equipment Market Association puts on the annual event where the latest and greatest automotive trends and technology are revealed!
programme.sub-title: Very Best Cars and Trucks of SEMA 2018

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: The Detroit Muscle crew transforms a 1970 Fastback Mustang into a track ready driver that will handle like it's on rails. Check it out from start to finish.
programme.sub-title: EBC Mustang: The Full Supercharged Coyote Build

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: We kick off a new Ford F150 build! We're at the Nashville Superspeedway for baseline tests, then we'll begin the transformation with a lowering kit, and we'll dress it up with new wheels and tires. By the way we're going to give this truck away!
programme.sub-title: Putting A 2020 Ford F-150 To The Test

programme.title: Detroit Muscle
programme.desc: Wired and inspired - The guys enter the winding maze of wiring as they install a new ECU. Then, it's out with the old and in with the new as Joel upgrades the sound deadening and Tommy puts a new shine on the original taillights.

programme.title: Truck Tech
programme.desc: LT & Austin purchase a 2011 Sierra Denali HD, plus they are on the road in Indy for coverage of the Ultimate Callout Challenge.
programme.sub-title: Extreme Diesel Rigs at Ultimate Callout Challenge

programme.title: Music City Trucks
programme.desc: Our Chevy Avalanche, Project DragAlanche, gets a stronger rear end featuring beefier gears and an upgraded braking system built to handle increased performance. Then the factory rear suspension is replaced with a fully adjustable 4-link setup, providing the tuning capability and traction needed for maximum grip and consistent launches down the drag strip.
programme.sub-title: Chevy DragAlanche - Part 3 The Ultimate Hook-Up

programme.title: Engine Power

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: When Winston Churchill becomes Prime Minister of the wartime coalition government in May 1940, he pledges his blood, toil, tears and sweat; within days of his appointment, he is made to honor his promise; with France near defeat and Allied soldiers trapped at Dunkirk, Churchill faces a critical challenge; capturing the drama and resilience that defined his leadership during Britain's darkest hour.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With mainland Europe under Hitler's control, the German Fuhrer turned his attention to Operation Sealion, and the Battle of Britain. However he'd underestimated the enormity of the task and the spirit of a nation inspired by Winston Churchill.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The processing of plasma and penicillin. Troops in Normandy receive medical care. Naval guns bombard Cherbourg. The 8th and 9th Air Forces bomb communication lines. British troops take Caen. Shows Gen. Montgomery.
programme.sub-title: First Aid and the Taking of Cherbourg

programme.title: Military Legends of World War II
programme.desc: True stories of the Medal of Honor, the highest award for valor which can be bestowed upon an individual serving in the Armed Services of the United States.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: Marine patrol action in Vietnam. Sequences show land and river patrols and a successful attack on a Viet Cong village. Emphasizes the importance of patrol action in maintaining contact with an elusive enemy.

programme.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
programme.desc: World War II at sea was marked by the rise of submarines, leading to fierce battles above and below the waves. Crews faced overcrowding and claustrophobia in these confined spaces. This technological evolution paved the way for modern submarines. Developed by Germany, submarines became as crucial to naval warfare as strategic bombers were to the skies, with other countries soon following suit.

programme.title: Vichy and the Nazis: A Deal with the Devil
programme.desc: 1942: Almost 80,000 French Jews are arrested, following the orders of Adolf Hitler and Vichy. From the Vel' d'Hiv Roundup to Auschwitz, thanks to the most recent historiography and reenactment, plunge into the making of the Holocaust.

programme.title: Hitler's Propaganda Machine
programme.desc: As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war - to be fought on many battlefields, and for the hearts and minds of the people.

programme.title: Nazi War Criminals
programme.desc: Nazi war criminals are put on trial for their war crimes committed during WWII. This program covers various events from the Lublin Massacre, German atrocities in concentration camps and many others
programme.sub-title: NEWSREEL FOOTAGE OF THE NAZI WAR CRIMINALS

programme.title: Visions of War: The Korean War
programme.desc: Covers the United States involvement with Korea and testing of Korean weapons. John Ford directed this film which is the only color documentary made during the Korean War.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: Japanese bombing of Pearl Harbor brings America to war.
programme.sub-title: America Goes to War in the Pacific

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at U.S. and British interests in the Pacific prior to World War II including Alaska, Hawaii, Guam, Australia, and New Zealand. It also looks at developments in Siam, China, and Japan focusing on the growth of modernization and militarism in Japan prior to the war.

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: For nearly five years, Hitler's Third Reich has dominated Europe. Germany braces for an Allied invasion, fortifying the Atlantic Wall with steel, concrete, and advanced weaponry. Led by the USA, a global alliance faces overwhelming odds, launching a massive military assault to break Germany's grip on Western Europe and reclaim freedom from Nazi control.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: The history of armed conflict is intrinsically tied to the history of civilization and Man's quest for the basic things in life. Over the centuries those weapons ranged from bow and arrows to armor, swords and chain mail. But one technological development left them all behind - the invention of gunpowder. Since then, the advances in weaponry have been both awe-inspiring, and frightening.

programme.title: Helicopter Warfare
programme.desc: In the Iraq War, flying in the desert poses unique difficulties - the dust storm that accompanies every landing and take-off - and the lack of places to hide. When a young Royal Navy pilot comes under fire from a tank, he soon finds himself engaged in a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Dawns Here are Quiet (English Version)
programme.desc: It is late spring of 1942, and World War 2 is in full swing. A long way off from the front-line the Germans make an air landing operation in an attempt to get through to the Kirov railway and the White Sea - Baltic Sea Canal. The only obstacle in their way is an anti-aircraft artillery unit of corporal Vaskov and five young women in training.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Speeding behind German lines the men of Troop A, in their armored cars and half-tracks left destruction and fear in their wake. Surprising the German garrison at the town of Epernay, they established an outpost from which they could defend a counter-attack. Outnumbered and outgunned with thirteen rounds of ammunition left, these brave GI's held this vital town until re-enforcements could arrive.

programme.title: After Hitler
programme.desc: May 1945: At last the Nazi shadow is lifting...War has devastated the continent, and now everyone just wants to get back to living again... But though the guns are now quiet, the Second World War isn't over yet. The Third Reich may have surrendered but the violence just won't seem to end.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The third episode opens with Rommel's second offensive in North Africa. The following summer the German offensive at Kharkov and the subsequent push past the River Don towards Volga and Stalingrad, later the scene of Germany's first major defeat - The Battle of Stalingrad. The scene is switched to North Africa following the continuous battle between the British 8th Army, the Desert Rats.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Russia In Afghanistan
programme.desc: In 1979, the Soviets had ill-suited uniforms and inferior fighting tactics, and found it impossible to defeat the popular Afghan guerrilla army. They had underestimated their enemy and lacked the forces to win.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Another basic building block of civilization and warfare is the ship. From the Second Millennia BC, ships were used to transport troops to battle. The Egyptians and Syrians crossed the sea to do battle, and when they weren't fighting each other, they would use their vessels for trade, exploration and probably a little piracy! From the 7th and 6th centuries B.C, formal navies appeared.

programme.title: Lidia's Italian Table
programme.desc: Caesar Salad is a staple on the Italian-American table, even though it's origin in Mexican. Lidia's version is the best of both, and shows us why it is probably America's most popular salad. And who doesn't love Lasagna? Lidia's is classic Italian-American Lassgna steeped in her special meat sauce.
programme.sub-title: Lidia's Italian Table - Lasagna & Caesar Salad

programme.title: Lidia's Italian Table
programme.desc: Lidia shares her technique for making a basic marinara, enthusiastically immersing herself in sauce making Lidia's way. She then prepares two faorite pasta dishes: a seafood vermicelli with fresh clams and scallops and a parchment wrapped, baked ziti with mozzarella, marinara and fresh basil. Tutti a tavola! She commands, and we follow joyfully.

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Krazy for Kale? Mary Ann is, when she creates Farfalle with Kale Sauce; as colorful to look at as it is wonderful to taste. programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - A Beautiful Plate of Pasta / Un Bellissimo Piatto di Pasta

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals

programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Essential Pastas of Rome

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: The rich flavors of Tuscany are ours to taste at Villa Dianella, a 15th century hunting lodge once owned by the Medicis. We're here to taste Chianti wines from the vineyard and then make a spectacular homemade Chianti red pasta filled with local goat cheese and spring asparagus.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Tuscan Villa Pasta

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Two of our favorite things come together in this episode - pasta and one pan meals. programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Pasta in a Pan

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: It's a stuffed pasta showdown as Sara travels to an ancient Tuscan villa to learn the secrets of homemade ravioli from a real Italian chef, a delicious but time-consuming task involving asparagus, goat cheese and a whole lot of chianti. Back home in her American kitchen, Sara shows us a hack to make a homemade ravioli stuffed with spicy greens, quick enough for a weeknight and pretty darn tasty. Which is best? Only the cook knows.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - BASTA PASTA: US VS ITALY

programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - It Is all about Pasta!

programme.title: Cooking with Nick Stellino

programme.sub-title: Cooking with Nick Stellino - Pasta with Bolognese Ragu and Strawberries with Zabaglione

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El estado de salud de Luzma es crítico, tuvo dos paros respiratorios y dos infartos. Las esperanzas de los Casillas se desvanecen y toman una decisión muy arriesgada que los puede hundir.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado quiere cerrar alianzas para eliminar al Cabo. Los Casillas dejan claro que nadie va a tocar a uno de los suyos. Castillo queda sorprendido con su visita nocturna.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Amado manda a preparar a sus hombres con explosivos, granadas y todo lo necesario para el gran ataque. Él le pide a Dalila que entregue la información de los laboratorios de Ojeda.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Casillas tienen rodeado el laboratorio de Ojeda y Amado se comunica con Dalila para que abandone el lugar. Ojeda desconfía de ella y la obliga a tener el teléfono en manos libres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una lluvia de balas en el laboratorio de Ojeda. El narco sabe que no tiene escapatoria y quiere eliminar a Dalila porque se siente traicionado. Pío no puede enviarle refuerzo a Ojeda.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los colombianos disfrutan su venganza y ubican a Alba, la abuela de los Casillas. Aunque Rutila la llama para advertirle, ya es tarde para escapar. Pío, Ojeda y sus hombres atacan el lugar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ojeda y Pío quieren ajustar cuentas con sus enemigos y tienen la fórmula para eliminar a los Casillas. Amado debe reaccionar rápidamente porque el mundo se le viene encima.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los actores que dan vida a la familia Casillas cuentan anécdotas, revelan lo que pasó detrás de cámara y hablan de las escenas más fuertes y de los romances.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Misteriosas fuerzas sacan a Aurelio Casillas de su última morada. La DEA lo tiene en sus manos, quiere establecer si el narco quita y pone presidentes, como Terán.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A solas, Mecha y Casillas se preguntan quién es quién, él se entera de qué perfil de hombre desea ella. Con un bisturí él se corta el área donde tiene el chip insertado, Mecha se lo extrae.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La mayor motivación de Aurelio es reunirse con su familia y hace todo lo posible para lograrlo. Tracy Lobo debe demostrar que puede detener a Casillas, su ascenso está en juego.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una persecución sin frenos desata una balacera entre la DEA y Aurelio Casillas. En el camino, Mecha lo ayuda sin saber quién es él, las descargas lo aturden. Aguirre reporta una baja.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mecha esconde a Aurelio en un túnel y el coqueteo surge de la nada. Lucas Manzano le da un ultimátum a Tracy Lobo: si no atrapa a Casillas a la medianoche, debe finalizar el operativo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El olfato de Tracy Lobo apunta a la fábrica de hielo donde está el escondite de Casillas, mientras él está abrumado por los recuerdos. Detienen al "Pollo" y da un falso testimonio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando los Casillas van a darle el último adiós a Doña Alba y "El Pulque", les tienden una trampa, atrás quedan las balas, el fentanilo es protagonista.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio confirma la muerte de su madre y se entera de que Luzma está grave. "Uña de tigre" le cuenta sobre el intento de asesinato múltiple en el funeral de Doña Alba, "Pío" lideró el ataque.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas es el Señor de los Cielos, va y viene del más allá cuando quiere y planta cara ante sus aliados. Don Julio daba por desaparecida a "La Soberana", ahora le da la bienvenida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Llenas de incredulidad, las especulaciones brotan por todos lados y a Ismael le toca la peor parte, recibe una visita que lo conmueve y lo enfurece. La orden de un juez llega al hospital.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina descubre el proyecto secreto con el que se fabricó la supuesta muerte de Aurelio Casillas, llamado "Código Lázaro". Ismael sorprende a Rutila, quien confundida reclama y se conmueve.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El video de vigilancia del hospital es una prueba de vida de Aurelio Casillas para Alfaro, pero a Manzano y a Colón no les convence. Corina confiesa su amor por el Señor de los Cielos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las sospechas señalan a Corina Saldaña como la infiltrada, su puesto en la DEA pende de un hilo. Aurelio Casillas se acerca a ella para saber si es cómplice de la estrategia de enterrarlo vivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El destino los une otra vez, "La Felina" no puede creer lo que ve con sus propios ojos y sin perder un segundo coloca dos toneladas de droga, una conexión directa entre México y Venezuela.
programme.sub-title: La mejor defensa es el ataque

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sebastián exige la custodia de la hija que tiene con Patricia. Sospecha que la madre abusa de ella. Juan Manuel cuidó de su madre enferma y tras su muerte, su hermana quiere sacarlo de la casa.
programme.sub-title: El muñeco de Bruselas: Herencia por cuidados

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Javier adopta a una niña de raza negra y la obliga a entrenar para convertirla en una deportista millonaria. Ligia es una artista y usa sus abortos para expresar su arte poco convencional.
programme.sub-title: Los morenos si saltan; Aborto en nombre del arte

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Para obtener mejores calificaciones en la universidad usa drogas regularmente. Andrés exige anular su matrimonio con Patricia y la custodia de su hijo. Ella se casó con una identidad falsa.
programme.sub-title: Se drogan para estudiar; La impostora

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: En su empresa, usan enanos que actúan como bebés para enseñar a los padres cómo criar a sus hijos. Mario exige que se cumpla la voluntad de su hermano, ser desconectado y donar sus órganos.
programme.sub-title: Enano como bebé; Trasplante en coma

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Raúl exige el divorcio y que Juana lo indemnice, ella tiene varios amantes y todos duermen en su cama. La hija de Valeria es producto de una violación, su difunto cuñado fue quien abusó de ella.
programme.sub-title: Cada país tiene su cabeza; Tu hermano me violó

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lo adopta, pero se arrepiente y le regala el niño a un hombre que conoció en internet. Manuel está preso por violación, pero quiere tener derechos como padre de la niña que nació del abuso.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Martín pide el divorcio, organiza un maratón de caridad y su esposa usa su trasero para recaudar más fondos. Oscar quiere anular el contrato prenupcial que firmó. Vania se embarazó de otro.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natalia acusa a su ex empleada de engañarla, pidió un permiso de maternidad, pero no tuvo ningún niño. Gio demanda a su madre, ella no le permite ver a su hermano mayor porque es homosexual.
programme.sub-title: Licencia por madre subrogada; Niño quiere ver a hermano gay

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Julio exige que Sofía le devuelva el dinero que pagó por sus cirugías; ella lo acusa de querer prostituirla. Anabel quiere recuperar la custodia de su hijo; teme por el bienestar del niño.
programme.sub-title: Esos senos son míos; Terapia orgánica

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marie quiere que Rodolfo le devuelva su hijo, él dice que lo hará solo si ella cambia de pareja. Jesús exige una indemnización, Mercedes resucitó a su anciana madre y ahora ella debe cuidarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yamily demanda a su hermano; él pretende invertir las cenizas de su abuela en un novedoso negocio. Susana pierde la custodia de sus hijos, intentó suicidarse por un trauma, fue abusada de niña.
programme.sub-title: Cenizas para facial; Abusada y sin sus hijas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana exige que Iván le pague salarios atrasados y reconozca la paternidad de su hijo. David quiere enterrar juntas a su madre y a la esposa de esta, pero la directora del cementerio no lo permite.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Antonella pide ayuda psicológica para su esposo, su trabajo lo convirtió en un hombre violento. Luisa se casa con Javier, él le ofrece los papeles, pero oculta su pasado como narcotraficante.
programme.sub-title: Boxeador desmemoriado; Ciudadanía en cuestión por droga

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Miller quiere anular su matrimonio con José, tiene ébola y lo ocultó, además vende su sangre infectada. Luis demanda a su exnovia, ella le complicó la vida al acusarlo de forzarla a tener sexo.
programme.sub-title: Ébola mortal; Ley en California: Sí significa sí

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Angélica descubre que su esposo y padre de su niña es un depredador sexual, pide el divorcio. Antonio pierde a su hijo cuando la madre desaparece, ahora le exige a su ex cuñada que lo devuelva.
programme.sub-title: "Depredador" en Halloween; Adopta, mi hijo no

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sueña con someterse a una cirugía plástica que le permita lucir igual que una muñeca. Florencia es joven, bella y de buen corazón, pero no es feliz; su cuerpo despide un olor nauseabundo.
programme.sub-title: La muñeca mujer maravilla; Olor a pescado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariana está enganchada a los selfies, su esposo la demanda, por su vicio, ya no tienen sexo. Tatiana pide la custodia de su sobrino, la madre está presa y su excuñado no es el padre biológico.
programme.sub-title: Mucho selfie, poco sexo; Estoy en el certificado, es mío

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Roberto es profesor y demanda a la madre de su novia, cuando ella descubrió la relación le dio una paliza. Victoria le exige a la amante de su marido que devuelva los bienes que él le entregó.
programme.sub-title: Profesor golpeado; Novia de ella y amante de la momia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jean quiere abortar, grabar el procedimiento y comercializar el video. Sofia, su ex, se opone. Killer acaba de salir de prisión y le exige a Fabiana, su excuñada, que le devuelva a sus gemelas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Catalina recibe fotos donde su jefe le muestra el miembro, ella lo denuncia y él la demanda. Además, Yassiri exige la custodia de las hijas de Jonathan, él es esquizofrénico y puede ser peligroso.
programme.sub-title: Fotos del miembro; Viudo esquizofrénico con custodia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mayra exige que su actual pareja le devuelva el dinero que le entregó porque necesita ayudar a su hijo. Rosa pide la custodia de su padre, su sobrina usa al abuelo para promocionar sus diseños.
programme.sub-title: Basta de indocumentados; Abuelo se pone vestido

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Martín, dueño de un canal online, demanda a Ivana porque usó la plataforma para vender drogas. Karina le pide a su ex que no abandone a su niña —no es su hija biológica—, pero ella no lo sabe.
programme.sub-title: Renuncia en TV por marihuana; Padrastro no quiere niña, ella sí

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nazarena le exige a su marido que desaloje a la mujer que la abandonó a los tres años, su madre biológica. Jessica tiene 14 años y un bebé; los abuelos paternos le piden que entregue al niño.
programme.sub-title: No quiero a mi prostituta madre; Niña de 14 quiere su hijo
